title: Add weekly status accuracy audit job (incident tags vs Statuspage updates)
author: Aisha Bello
description: Motivation: We’ve had recurring cases where the public status page didn’t reflect the impacted capability/region (e.g., streaming-only or embeddings-only degradations) even though the incident was tagged correctly internally, and vice-versa. This PR adds a lightweight weekly audit job to detect mismatches between (a) incident metadata (component_id/region/capability + severity + impact window) and (b) the Statuspage incident updates/components that were actually published. The goal is not to page or create more on-call work; it’s to produce a small, actionable report for follow-up during business hours and feed the status page transparency success metric (accuracy audits). What it does: 1) Runs weekly (Mon 09:00 PT) as a Kubernetes CronJob in the internal tooling cluster. 2) Pulls incidents from the incident timeline export endpoint (incident-bot export) for the prior 7 days, filtering to Sev0/Sev1 and any Sev2 that included a customer-facing status update flag. 3) Pulls corresponding Statuspage incidents/updates for the same time window using the internal Statuspage API client credentials (read-only). 4) Compares: (a) component_id list (including region/capability split), (b) first public update timestamp vs incident start (TTFU heuristic), and (c) whether the incident was marked resolved on Statuspage within 60 minutes of internal resolution. 5) Emits a report to #status-accuracy-audits (and #eng-sre on >N mismatches) with links to the incident, the Statuspage incident, and a short “likely fix” hint (e.g., missing region tag, component map mismatch, anti-flap prevented update, wrong capability selected). 6) Exposes Prometheus metrics for trend tracking (mismatch_count, ttfu_minutes_p50/p90, missing_component_tag_count) and adds a Grafana panel link in the output. Scope/Non-goals: This does not auto-edit Statuspage, does not create Linear tickets automatically (by design), and does not attempt to infer “true customer impact” from raw SLO data; it only checks consistency between internal incident tags and what we published. Safety/Noise controls: (a) Uses a allowlist of components that are currently GA on the public status page; anything behind rollout flags is reported as “skipped” to avoid false positives during rollout. (b) Has a minimum-duration threshold (default 5 min) before considering a mismatch relevant. (c) Dedupes repeated incidents due to Statuspage edits. (d) Stores the last audit cursor (time window) in a small ConfigMap to avoid double-reporting on reruns. Testing: Unit tests cover component normalization, time-window matching, and dedupe logic. Integration tests use recorded fixtures for both incident-bot export and Statuspage API responses. Rollout plan: Deploy to staging for 1 week with reports going to #status-accuracy-audits-staging, then enable prod schedule. Related: This supports the Status page transparency upgrades initiative and complements component mapping/schema work (ENG-4830) and incident-bot statuspage integration (ENG-4822).

cronjob: wire weekly schedule + RBAC + config defaults
metrics: add prometheus counters/gauges + grafana panel link
tests: fixtures for incident export + statuspage API + normalization cases
docs: add runbook snippet and troubleshooting notes for audit failures

Example Slack output (trimmed):
- 2025-11-19 INC-1760048421 (Sev1): internal tags=[hosted.streaming/us-east] statuspage components=[hosted.api/us-east] => MISMATCH (capability)

review_conversation: Rafael Mendes (review): Love the direction. Two asks: (1) please make sure this never pages on-call; Slack-only is fine. (2) Can we include the statuspage incident id + component ids in the report so we can grep patterns?

Aisha Bello (author): Ack on both. No paging hooks added; only posts to #status-accuracy-audits with an optional secondary channel ping when mismatch_count > threshold. Added explicit statuspage_incident_id and component_id lists to the Slack block + JSON log line.
Allison Grant (review): Metrics naming: can we align labels with the public taxonomy schema? component_id/region/capability keys should match the registry to make dashboards consistent.

Aisha Bello (author): Updated metric labels to component_id, region, capability and added normalization via the same enum set used by slo-toolkit SLO labels. Added tests for a few edge cases (us-east vs us_east).
Christine Wong (review): The window matching logic worries me: statuspage updates can be edited later. How are we preventing double counting on reruns?

Aisha Bello (author): Added dedupe key = (incident_id, statuspage_incident_id, impact_start_rounded_5m). Also persists last_successful_window_end in a ConfigMap so reruns only re-check the most recent window. Edits still show up as a single row but with latest updated_at.
Miles Thornton (review): Please add a small runbook note for when the job itself fails (auth, API 429, etc). Also, rate limiting/backoff?

Aisha Bello (author): Added exponential backoff w/ jitter for Statuspage calls and hard cap (max 3 retries). Failures report a single ‘audit job degraded’ message to the channel with the error class + action, and emits audit_job_errors_total.
Rafael Mendes (approval): Approved after latest changes. This should help us quantify accuracy gaps without adding on-call load.
Allison Grant (approval): Approved. Thanks for aligning labels + adding fixtures.
release_notes: Internal: Adds a weekly status accuracy audit job comparing incident tags vs Statuspage component updates and reporting mismatches to #status-accuracy-audits.
Internal: Emits metrics for mismatch counts and TTFU distributions to support transparency initiative measurement.
